title: Trump says he’ll be impeached if Republicans lose midterms

title: Crypto adoption inevitable as old money will flow into crypto

title: Gold, silver briefly reclaim top spot by market cap amid uncertainty
summary: Gold and silver, both seen as “stores of value,” briefly retook their position as the two biggest assets by market cap. Bitcoin sits in the eighth position.
